title: Fourier truncation through degree k
statement: For a function $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and an integer $k\ge 0$, its low-degree part through degree $k$ is the function $x\mapsto\sum_{S\subseteq[n],\,|S|\le k}\widehat f(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ and $\chi_S$ is the monomial indexed by $S$.
